purpose: One bounded remaining-wait screen of own prior Union departure age for Red Winchester; no application or production edits.
training: Same160 completed holds with outcomes known before2026-09-14T04:00:00Z; original six dates. Each hold contributes ONE ordinary event-history survival likelihood, no repeated-landmark training and no outcome-dependent inverse-landmark weights in fit.
evaluation: Original285 visits;125 later visits at elapsed0,60,180,300,480 when still held. Sep14–17 and Sep18 separate. Earlier dates are reused development; Sep18 had binary-screen inspection before this experiment, so is chronological follow-up rather than untouched confirmation.
featureContract: Latch latest own legacy Union departure <=pin−120sec, same local day and age0–7200sec. Exact origin verified against original forecast-time features; it does not change at any existing landmark. Age advances deterministically in future hazard bins; no future bus observation, next arrival, or current outcome enters feature.
hazardFeatures: supported own lap fixed at pin centered at training reference /600
candidateFeatures: own Union departure age at future bin minus training median pin-age, divided by600; zero if missing
own Union origin missing at pin
fit: 15sec exposure bins; fixed L2=4 on non-intercept coefficients, no standardization/tuning or calibration. One end event per hold; holds>1800sec contribute censored exposure through1800 without deletion. Fit two models independently on matched rows.
prediction: Runtime-like pin-phase and lap quantization to5sec, log-linear survival between15sec knots, stable conditional inversion, continued bounded exponential tail beyond1800. Future own-Union age is deterministic elapsed since latched departure. Unsupported lap retained with missingness in matched research arms, and actual runtime component uses its existing marginal fallback.
weighting: Main descriptive totals average landmarks within each visit then visits equally; this estimates a visit-balanced sampled-landmark population, not live per-poll calibrated probabilities. Fixed-age summaries use equal visits. Also report checkpoint-equal totals.
metrics: departure before lower/after upper bound counts/rates
median overprediction>120s (bus left earlier than point forecast)
runtimeComparator: Call unchanged current fitRelease on SAME preSep14 training rows, actual releaseDist/releaseResidual and actual marginal/lap fallback for unsupported laps; frozen fit/tables, not whole served ETA or six-hour live update. No full replay in this bounded task.
exclusions: Exactly parent cohort; preserve all genuine early and long waits, no residual trimming. Only prior independently verified restart truncation65237 is quarantined by parent. Parent exclusions retained.
resource: All fits and runtime comparison under overnight-2026-09-17/heavy.lock, one BLAS thread.
claimLimit: Association/component distribution screen only; no driver instruction, calibrated probability, safe minimum, model-selection or deployment claim.
